title: 全球贸易没打起来：央行却突然加息，整条曲线收益率上行会压住谁？
speaker: Isabelle Mateos y Lago

segments.en: Partly because the US tariff shock was much lower than announced, partly because there was hardly any retaliation, so there was no global trade war.
segments.zh: 部分因为美国关税冲击远低于宣布水平，部分因为几乎没有报复，所以没有全球贸易战。

segments.en: In fact, global trade continued to boom as if there had been no tariff action.
segments.zh: 事实上，全球贸易继续繁荣，仿佛没有关税行动。

segments.en: But throughout most of last year, central banks across the world were delivering rate cuts after rate cuts.
segments.zh: 但去年大部分时间，全球央行接连降息。

segments.en: This year we have a clear inflationary shock, and because it's the second in a row, central banks have decided that we can't look through it.
segments.zh: 今年我们面临明显的通胀冲击，因为是连续第二次，央行决定不能视而不见。

segments.en: And instead they've started raising interest rates. So that's a big factor of support that was there last year that isn't here this year.
segments.zh: 相反，他们开始加息。这是去年有而今年没有的一大支撑因素。

segments.en: And this hawkish talk from central banks has contributed, I think, very significantly to the rise in bond yields throughout the curve.
segments.zh: 我认为央行的鹰派言论对整条曲线收益率上行贡献显著。

segments.en: Which is proving to be much more of a headwind than people had anticipated earlier in the year.
segments.zh: 这被证明比年初人们预期的逆风要大得多。

segments.en: And then you have the AI boom as well to account for. What is your sense of what this is doing in terms of driving the economy, both on the inflation but also the growth front?
segments.zh: 还有AI热潮需要考虑。您认为这对经济和通胀、增长有何驱动？

segments.en: Yes, so you have basically a global capex boom. A lot of that is AI, but it's not just AI.
segments.zh: 是的，基本上是一场全球资本开支热潮。很大部分是AI，但不只是AI。

segments.en: You also have, particularly in Europe, defense investment playing a big part, and across different parts of the world, infrastructure.
segments.zh: 尤其在欧洲，防务投入也扮演重要角色，世界各地还有基础设施。

segments.en: So these are the three pillars. AI is the biggest. It's been playing a very significant role in sustaining the manufacturing sector.
segments.zh: 这是三大支柱。AI最大，在支撑制造业方面发挥了非常重要的作用。

segments.en: And again, people tend to think, oh well, it's mostly a US and Asia story, and it's a big story there.
segments.zh: 人们往往认为这主要是美国和亚洲的故事，那里确实很重要。

segments.en: In the US, accounts for maybe half of growth if you take into account the wealth effect that consumers are benefiting from, at least those who own stocks.
segments.zh: 在美国，若计入消费者财富效应，至少持股者受益，可能贡献一半增长。

segments.en: But even in Europe, if you look at industrial production, you're seeing growth at double digits over the last year or so in sectors related to AI, like electronics, optics, etc., as well as defense.
segments.zh: 但即使欧洲，看工业生产，过去一年左右AI相关领域如电子、光学以及防务都实现两位数增长。

segments.en: And then you have other sectors which are more exposed to the energy shock, like the chemical industry, that's doing very poorly, or the automobile sector is still doing relatively poorly.
segments.zh: 而其他更受能源冲击影响的行业，如化工表现很差，汽车行业也相对疲弱。
